checks: Empty workspace; no examples loaded automatically
Incomplete record saved and hand-off blocked
Correction revalidates record without creating a duplicate
Recorded external hand-off requires reference and deliberate actor
Records and action history survive refresh
Deadline produces visible overdue state using wall-clock time (controlled test clock)
Approved retry, second hand-off, receipt reference and post-hand-off edit restriction
Optional examples retain user record and never duplicate on reload
Mobile layout without horizontal overflow; no browser errors
Reset cancellation and incorrect confirmation preserve records
Export from reset dialog contains current records, history and settings
Confirmed reset restores defaults, persists empty after refresh, and permits new entries
scope: Local browser workflow with a controlled test clock. No network integration, authenticated identity, clinical validation, or production audit.
